title: A standalone Codex account action that fails with a retiring leftover blocks standalone Codex, with /login as the only way out
outcome: A failed account action in Standalone mode never leaves standalone Codex blocked: status or useStandalone retries reaping the leftover Codex process and restores the standalone view.
acceptance: In Standalone mode, an account action that fails while a retiring Codex process remains does not leave standalone Codex sends blocked without a standalone route back, shown by a behaviour test.
The managed-account fences for unconfirmed logins are unchanged.
